notes.title: Espirito Delusion is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[p]Use the power of imagination, solve puzzles, interact with mysterious entities, and fight turn-based battles with unique SIN and FAITH mechanics. Featuring turn-based combat with skill progression, four playable characters, an original soundtrack, a dark atmosphere, and retro-style 3D graphics, you'll be immersed in a completely unique world.[/p][p]Now available on Steam. Play now and face the worst… inside and out.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3560420/Espirito_Delusion/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Perimbó is now available!
notes.notes:
Jaime was playing in the forest when he was attracted by a bird and ended up falling into a deep and mysterious cave. Now, he must escape while uncovering the secrets of this place.  

Use the power of the sacred necklace, solve challenging puzzles, discover secrets, collect artifacts, and free lost souls as you fight to find your way back to the surface.  

🔥 But that’s not all!  
Besides Perimbó, Gigantic G has other games available on Steam! Come explore new worlds, face challenges, and live unforgettable adventures!  

👉 Add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346170/Perimb/]Perimbó [/url]to your library and get ready to uncover the mysteries of the cave or add it to you wishlist
